name: Yizumi Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Yizumi Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in designs, researches and develops, manufactures, sells, and services of various molding machines in China and internationally. The company offers injection molding machines, die-casting machines, rubber injection molding machines, industrial 3D printing machines, thixo molding machines, and related supporting products, as well as robotic automation systems and intelligent manufacturing solutions. It serves automobiles, home appliances, medical devices, 3C products, packaging, and aerospace industries.
